messages:
maria: Quick note: found a compact repro for the JS SDK breaking when bundled for edge runtimes. Errors include 'Cannot use import statement outside a module' or SyntaxError on 'export'.
kevin: which SDK and bundlers?
maria: @redwood/inference-js (installed from npm). Hits on Vite (SSR -> edge), Rollup builds, and Webpack targeting webworker. Minimal repro below.

maria: package.json (project):
{
  "type": "module",
  "dependencies": { "@redwood/inference-js": "0.1.0" }
}

// index.mjs
import { createClient } from '@redwood/inference-js';
console.log(createClient());

maria: When bundling, resolver sometimes picks up dist/runtime.cjs.js or other CJS artifacts from the package, which fails in edge (no node shims).

olivia: any quick workarounds?
maria: For consumers:
- Vite SSR (edge): set optimizeDeps.include = ['@redwood/inference-js'] and ssr.noExternal = ['@redwood/inference-js']
- Rollup: ensure @rollup/plugin-commonjs wraps the dep
- Webpack (webworker): add rule for .mjs and use type: 'javascript/auto'

sam: sounds like an exports/conditional export mismatch in the package. Do you have the installed package.json from node_modules?
maria: yes: package had main -> dist/index.cjs.js, module -> dist/index.esm.js, and an exports map but older releases didn't provide explicit "import" vs "require" targets for internal runtime files. Also the .d.ts used `export =` style which muddies TS ESM imports.

kevin: thanks. I'll open an SDK issue to: add explicit conditional exports (import/require/types), publish corrected types (named exports), and add a CI bundler smoke for edge.

maria: created repro repo (private) and added a short Rollup config that reproduces:
// rollup.config.js
export default { input: 'index.mjs', output: { format: 'es', file: 'bundle.js' }, plugins: [require('@rollup/plugin-node-resolve').nodeResolve(), require('@rollup/plugin-commonjs')()] }

maria: if commonjs plugin misses a pattern, runtime ends up with mixed artifacts.

olivia: action items:
1) kevin -> SDK exports/types patch + publish
2) sam -> add the repro to devex repros and a short CI test
3) olivia -> docs blurb with Vite/Rollup/Webpack quick fixes

ci-bot: opened issue redwood/inference-js#342 (labels: bug, bundler, edge, types) and started matrix run (vite/rollup/webpack).

kevin: will PR a patch that adds explicit exports fields for "import" and "require", fixes d.ts to named exports, and publishes a patch. Will post PR link when ready.

maria: thanks all, drop any variant logs here if you see other error messages. :thumbsup:
